g.text: Dry Eye Disease (건성안) — Integrated QSP Mechanistic Map
Tear-Film Instability · Hyperosmolar Stress · Innate/Adaptive Ocular-Surface Inflammation · Corneal Neurosensory Dysfunction · Vicious-Cycle Self-Perpetuation
